name: Article 3, § 2 – 89
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: Modification (2) Those contributions shall correspond to 11% of the revenues that each Member State has collected from the sale of CBAM certificates pursuant to Article 20 of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 in relation to embedded emissions declared for 2026 and 2027.
